note: 21 cm Morser 18 in firing position, a four-view with the tube level and the platform down. No scale on the sheet: the side view puts the bore 1.78 m over the ground at 48 px/m, which makes the barrel from the muzzle to the back of the block's carrier the published 6.51 m; the front view is drawn at the same height of bore. The pin is the middle of the platform on the ground.
